item.text: Using the built-in `image_gen` tool for generation and local filesystem commands only for placement/receipt. I’ll inspect the Embry reference first, then generate the single frame from that identity input.

Reference identity is visible: Embry has tied-back brown hair, warm tan complexion, rounded jaw, expressive brown eyes, and a navy top. I’m passing that image as the required identity reference into `image_gen` now.

Generation produced a PNG at `/home/graham/.codex/generated_images/019f8b92-5422-7a71-bf55-4d077bfe22df/call_yWCPHA0iB9naPk7OthrKa8Qn.png`. I’m copying that exact PNG to the requested frame path and deriving the receipt from the resulting bytes.

item.command:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "set -euo pipefail
src='/home/graham/.codex/generated_images/019f8b92-5422-7a71-bf55-4d077bfe22df/call_yWCPHA0iB9naPk7OthrKa8Qn.png'
dst='/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills-main/skills/persona-dream/reports/goal_v3/cycles/cycle_20260722T203423Z/frames/sb_004.attempt_01.png'
receipt='/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills-main/skills/persona-dream/reports/goal_v3/cycles/cycle_20260722T203423Z/frames/sb_004.attempt_01_scillm_image_generation_receipt.json'
mkdir -p \""'$(dirname "$dst")"
cp "$src" "$dst"
sha=$(sha256sum "$dst" | awk '"'{print "'$1}'"')
if command -v identify >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  read -r width height < <(identify -format '%w %h' \""'$dst")
else
  read -r width height < <(file "$dst" | sed -n '"'s/.*PNG image data, \\([0-9][0-9]*\\) x \\([0-9][0-9]*\\).*/\\1 \\2/p')
fi
node -e 'const fs=require(\"fs\"); const [receipt,path,width,height,sha]=process.argv.slice(1); fs.writeFileSync(receipt, JSON.stringify({ok:true,auth:\"Codex OAuth subscription via built-in image_gen\",path,width:Number(width),height:Number(height),sha256:sha}, null, 2)+\"\\n\");' \""'$receipt" "$dst" "$width" "$height" "$sha"
test -f "$dst"
test -f "$receipt"
printf '"'dst=%s\\nreceipt=%s\\nwidth=%s\\nheight=%s\\nsha256=%s\\n' \""'$dst" "$receipt" "$width" "$height" "$sha"'

item.text: The first placement command exited nonzero before emitting diagnostics, so no receipt was written from that attempt. I’m rerunning the same placement in `bash` with explicit checks so the failure point is visible and bounded.

src=\"/home/graham/.codex/generated_images/019f8b92-5422-7a71-bf55-4d077bfe22df/call_yWCPHA0iB9naPk7OthrKa8Qn.png\"

item.text: The rerun showed the failure was shell quoting around `awk` under `set -u`, not the generated image. I’m switching to `cut` for the SHA field and then verifying both exact target files.

item.command:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
src=\"/home/graham/.codex/generated_images/019f8b92-5422-7a71-bf55-4d077bfe22df/call_yWCPHA0iB9naPk7OthrKa8Qn.png\"
dst=\"/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills-main/skills/persona-dream/reports/goal_v3/cycles/cycle_20260722T203423Z/frames/sb_004.attempt_01.png\"
receipt=\"/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills-main/skills/persona-dream/reports/goal_v3/cycles/cycle_20260722T203423Z/frames/sb_004.attempt_01_scillm_image_generation_receipt.json\"
[[ -f \""'$src" ]] || { printf "missing src: %s'"\\n\" \""'$src"; exit 2; }
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$dst")"
cp "$src" "$dst"
sha=$(sha256sum "$dst" | cut -d " " -f 1)
if command -v identify >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dims=$(identify -format "%w %h" "$dst")
else
  dims=$(file "$dst" | sed -n "s/.*PNG image data, '"\\\\([0-9][0-9]*\\\\) x \\\\([0-9][0-9]*\\\\).*/\\\\1 \\\\2/p\")
fi
read -r width height <<< \""'$dims"
node - "$receipt" "$dst" "$width" "$height" "$sha" <<'"'\"'\"'NODE'\"'\"'
const fs = require(\"fs\");
const [receipt, path, width, height, sha256] = process.argv.slice(2);
fs.writeFileSync(receipt, JSON.stringify({
  ok: true,
  auth: \"Codex OAuth subscription via built-in image_gen\",
  path,
  width: Number(width),
  height: Number(height),
  sha256
}, null, 2) + \"\\n\");
NODE
[[ -f \""'$dst" ]] || { printf "missing dst'"\\n\"; exit 3; }
[[ -f \""'$receipt" ]] || { printf "missing receipt'"\\n\"; exit 4; }
printf \"dst=%s\\nreceipt=%s\\nwidth=%s\\nheight=%s\\nsha256=%s\\n\" \""'$dst" "$receipt" "$width" "$height" "$sha"
'"'"
